{"concept_id":"drv.interaction.overtake_pass","kind":"formula","contract":"Road user a overtakes and passes road user b from the rear: a, travelling in the same direction as b, comes from having b ahead of it to having b behind it. b is ahead of a where the longitudinal component of b's bearing in a's frame (rel.bearing) is positive and the two bodies' projections on a's heading share no length (rel.longitudinal_overlap negative); b is behind a where that component is negative and the projections share no length. The act begins at the last observation of the window behind at which b was ahead of a with their headings aligned within same_dir_cos (rel.same_direction). The act is recognized at the observation at which b is behind a and was not behind a at the previous observation, where b was ahead of a with headings aligned at some observation of the window behind. The concept holds at that observation only, and not again until b has again been ahead of a and then comes to be behind it. Conduct before the window behind is not read: a pass that takes longer than the window is not recognized. It denotes the relative motion of the two road users only: it says nothing of the lanes they occupy, of whether b moves, or of why a passes. 'of any kind or character' adds no restriction and removes none beyond the definition; the aggregate is one atom and is not expanded."},{"span":"s4","atoms":["rel.occupies","st.highway"],"derived":[],"justification":"Same words and meaning as the index's 'on a highway' -> rel.occupies, st.highway. st.highway: 'the entire public way between its boundary lines, including sidewalks and shoulders', which is the defined 'entire width between the boundary lines of every way dedicated to a public authority'; it is not the roadway, and the words do not narrow to the roadway. rel.occupies: 'a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region' anchors the subject on that highway."}],"operationalizations":[{"span":"s3","standard":"careless or imprudent manner","concepts":["prim.closest_approach_within","prim.closest_approach_distance","rel.contact"],"params":["p.conflict_horizon","p.conflict_centre_clearance"],"convention":"traffic-conflict technique: driving is read as careless or imprudent where, while the subject moves, it collides with another road user (rel.contact) or another road user's centre and the subject's, under constant velocities, approach within p.conflict_horizon to a centre distance below p.conflict_centre_clearance (a critical conflict). {"node_id":"LVMC_11_22_120_B","law_refs":["LVMC-11-22-120-B"],"subject":{"binder":"subject","class_elements":["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic"]},"segmentation":[{"id":"b1","text":"The City Traffic Engineer is authorized to determine and designate those heavily traveled streets","role":"condition"},{"id":"b2","text":"upon which shall be prohibited the use of the roadway","role":"condition"},{"id":"b3","text":"by motor-driven cycles, bicycles, horse-drawn vehicles or other nonmotorized traffic","role":"condition"},{"id":"b4","text":"and shall erect appropriate signs giving notice thereof","role":"condition"},{"id":"b5","text":"When signs are erected giving notice thereof","role":"trigger"},{"id":"b6","text":"no person shall disobey the restriction stated on such signs","role":"obligation"}],"elements":[{"span":"b1","atoms":["dev.regulatory_sign","dev.governs","st.roadway"],"derived":[],"justification":"The designation of a street is a legal status no scene shows; the ontology reads the legal status of a feature through the feature's presence: the regulatory sign (dev.regulatory_sign, 'a point regulation by catalogue code') governing the street's roadway (dev.governs, 'the travel regions whose traffic the device controls'; st.roadway, 'the part of a highway improved for vehicular traffic'). 'heavily traveled' is the engineer's criterion for designating, which the posted sign presumes."},{"span":"b2","atoms":["rel.occupies","st.roadway"],"derived":[],"justification":"'the use of the roadway' is presence on it: rel.occupies, 'a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region', on st.roadway, 'the part of a highway improved for vehicular traffic, excluding shoulder', which is the defined 'portion of a highway which is improved and ordinarily used for vehicular traffic, exclusive of the shoulder'. 'any person' is the one who drives: the duty binds the vehicle's conduct whoever controls it."},{"span":"s2","atoms":["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"],"derived":[],"justification":"'vehicle' is a defined term of this law with the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle: '“Vehicle” means every device in, upon or by which any person or property is or may be transported or drawn upon a highway', with its exceptions (human-powered devices, electric bicycles, EPAMDs, electric scooters) made by the reading's classification. 'of any kind or character' adds no restriction and removes none beyond the definition; the aggregate is one atom and is not expanded."},{"span":"s4","atoms":["rel.occupies","st.highway"],"derived":[],"justification":"Same words and meaning as the index's 'on a highway' -> rel.occupies, st.highway. st.highway: 'the entire public way between its boundary lines, including sidewalks and shoulders', which is the defined 'entire width between the boundary lines of every way dedicated to a public authority'; it is not the roadway, and the words do not narrow to the roadway. rel.occupies: 'a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region' anchors the subject on that highway."}],"operationalizations":[{"span":"s3","standard":"careless or imprudent manner","concepts":["prim.closest_approach_within","prim.closest_approach_distance","rel.contact"],"params":["p.conflict_horizon","p.conflict_centre_clearance"],"convention":"traffic-conflict technique: driving is read as careless or imprudent where, while the subject moves, it collides with another road user (rel.contact) or another road user's centre and the subject's, under constant velocities, approach within p.conflict_horizon to a centre distance below p.conflict_centre_clearance (a critical conflict). Care is a state of mind and the whole duty is this standard, so the rule is a surrogate.","surrogate":true}],"assumptions":[{"span":"s5","id":"asm.within_city_limits","meaning":"the place of the road user at the observation lies within the territorial limits of the incorporated city whose ordinances the reading applies, as the map's reading classifies the area"}],"intentions":[],"compositions":[],"residues":[],"binders":[{"name":"subject","class_elements":["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"]}],"applicability":"The subject is a member of the vehicle aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle, its footprint occupies a highway region (st.highway), asm.within_city_limits holds at the observation, and the subject is moving (kin.speed above p.halt_speed_tolerance).","obligation":"No other road user u of the scene (any class) is in contact with the subject (rel.contact), and no other road user u is such that, under constant velocities, the subject's and u's centres approach within p.conflict_horizon (prim.closest_approach_within) to a closest-approach centre distance below p.conflict_centre_clearance (prim.closest_approach_distance). Surrogate: the verdict is evidence of carelessness, not a legal conclusion.","params":["p.halt_speed_tolerance","p.conflict_horizon","p.conflict_centre_clearance"],"narrowings":[{"span":"s1","why":"'drive or operate' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion: a moving vehicle is taken to be driven, whoever or whatever controls it.","kind":"observable_reading","category":"agency"},{"span":"s3","why":"'careless or imprudent' is read only through a collision or a critical conflict with another road user; careless conduct that produces neither (inattention, erratic lane keeping with no one near, harsh braking) is not read.","kind":"reading"}],"scenarios":[{"name":"forbid","expected":"violated","narrative":"The subject car moves at 15 m/s on a highway inside the city (asm.within_city_limits declared true) toward a car halted ahead in its lane; lines: {"node_id":"LVMC_11_22_020","law_refs":["LVMC-11-22-020"],"subject":{"binder":"subject","class_elements":["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"]},"segmentation":[{"id":"s1","text":"It is unlawful for any person to drive or operate","role":"obligation"},{"id":"s2","text":"a vehicle of any kind or character","role":"subject"},{"id":"s3","text":"in a careless or imprudent manner","role":"standard"},{"id":"s4","text":"on any highway","role":"condition"},{"id":"s5","text":"in the City","role":"condition"}],"elements":[{"span":"s1","atoms":["kin.speed"],"derived":[],"justification":"'drive or operate' names who controls the vehicle, which no atom observes; per the ontology's section on what is not an atom it is read through the vehicle's controlled motion, 'a vehicle moving on the road is taken to be driven'. kin.speed, 'magnitude of velocity', tells the moving vehicle (speed above p.halt_speed_tolerance) from one at rest; it is used for motion, not as a stand-in for acceleration or a manoeuvre. 'any person' is the one who drives: the duty binds the vehicle's conduct whoever controls it."},{"span":"s2","atoms":["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"],"derived":[],"justification":"'vehicle' is a defined term of this law with the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle: '“Vehicle” means every device in, upon or by which any person or property is or may be transported or drawn upon a highway', with its exceptions (human-powered devices, electric bicycles, EPAMDs, electric scooters) made by the reading's classification. 'of any kind or character' adds no restriction and removes none beyond the definition; the aggregate is one atom and is not expanded."},{"span":"s4","atoms":["rel.occupies","st.highway"],"derived":[],"justification":"Same words and meaning as the index's 'on a highway' -> rel.occupies, st.highway. st.highway: 'the entire public way between its boundary lines, including sidewalks and shoulders', which is the defined 'entire width between the boundary lines of every way dedicated to a public authority'; it is not the roadway, and the words do not narrow to the roadway. rel.occupies: 'a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region' anchors the subject on that highway."}],"operationalizations":[{"span":"s3","standard":"careless or imprudent manner","concepts":["prim.closest_approach_within","prim.closest_approach_distance","rel.contact"],"params":["p.conflict_horizon","p.conflict_centre_clearance"],"convention":"traffic-conflict technique: driving is read as careless or imprudent where, while the subject moves, it collides with another road user (rel.contact) or another road user's centre and the subject's, under constant velocities, approach within p.conflict_horizon to a centre distance below p.conflict_centre_clearance (a critical conflict). Care is a state of mind and the whole duty is this standard, so the rule is a surrogate.","surrogate":true}],"assumptions":[{"span":"s5","id":"asm.within_city_limits","meaning":"the place of the road user at the observation lies within the territorial limits of the incorporated city whose ordinances the reading applies, as the map's reading classifies the area"}],"intentions":[],"compositions":[],"residues":[],"binders":[{"name":"subject","class_elements":["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"]}],"applicability":"The subject is a member of the vehicle aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle, its footprint occupies a highway region (st.highway), asm.within_city_limits holds at the observation, and the subject is moving (kin.speed above p.halt_speed_tolerance).","obligation":"No other road user u of the scene (any class) is in contact with the subject (rel.contact), and no other road user u is such that, under constant velocities, the subject's and u's centres approach within p.conflict_horizon (prim.closest_approach_within) to a closest-approach centre distance below p.conflict_centre_clearance (prim.closest_approach_distance). Surrogate: the verdict is evidence of carelessness, not a legal conclusion.","params":["p.halt_speed_tolerance","p.conflict_horizon","p.conflict_centre_clearance"],"narrowings":[{"span":"s1","why":"'drive or operate' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion: a moving vehicle is taken to be driven, whoever or whatever controls it.","kind":"observable_reading","category":"agency"},{"span":"s3","why":"'careless or imprudent' is read only through a collision or a critical conflict with another road user; careless conduct that produces neither (inattention, erratic lane keeping with no one near, harsh braking) is not read.","kind":"reading"}],"scenarios":[{"name":"forbid","expected":"violated","narrative":"The subject car moves at 15 m/s on a highway inside the city (asm.within_city_limits declared true) toward a car halted ahead in its lane; lines: {"node_id":"LVMC_11_22_020","law_refs":["LVMC-11-22-020"],"subject":{"binder":"subject","class_elements":["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"]},"segmentation":[{"id":"s1","text":"It is unlawful for any person to drive or operate","role":"obligation"},{"id":"s2","text":"a vehicle of any kind or character","role":"subject"},{"id":"s3","text":"in a careless or imprudent manner","role":"standard"},{"id":"s4","text":"on any highway","role":"condition"},{"id":"s5","text":"in the City","role":"condition"}],"elements":[{"span":"s1","atoms":["kin.speed"],"derived":[],"justification":"'drive or operate' names who controls the vehicle, which no atom observes; per the ontology's section on what is not an atom it is read through the vehicle's controlled motion, 'a vehicle moving on the road is taken to be driven'. kin.speed, 'magnitude of velocity', tells the moving vehicle (speed above p.halt_speed_tolerance) from one at rest; it is used for motion, not as a stand-in for acceleration or a manoeuvre. 'any person' is the one who drives: the duty binds the vehicle's conduct whoever controls it."},{"span":"s2","atoms":["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"],"derived":[],"justification":"'vehicle' is a defined term of this law with the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle: '“Vehicle” means every device in, upon or by which any person or property is or may be transported or drawn upon a highway', with its exceptions (human-powered devices, electric bicycles, EPAMDs, electric scooters) made by the reading's classification. 'of any kind or character' adds no restriction and removes none beyond the definition; the aggregate is one atom and is not expanded."},{"span":"s4","atoms":["rel.occupies","st.highway"],"derived":[],"justification":"Same words and meaning as the index's 'on a highway' -> rel.occupies, st.highway. st.highway: 'the entire public way between its boundary lines, including sidewalks and shoulders', which is the defined 'entire width between the boundary lines of every way dedicated to a public authority'; it is not the roadway, and the words do not narrow to the roadway. rel.occupies: 'a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region' anchors the subject on that highway."}],"operationalizations":[{"span":"s3","standard":"careless or imprudent manner","concepts":["prim.closest_approach_within","prim.closest_approach_distance","rel.contact"],"params":["p.conflict_horizon","p.conflict_centre_clearance"],"convention":"traffic-conflict technique: driving is read as careless or imprudent where, while the subject moves, it collides with another road user (rel.contact) or another road user's centre and the subject's, under constant velocities, approach within p.conflict_horizon to a centre distance below p.conflict_centre_clearance (a critical conflict). Care is a state of mind and the whole duty is this standard, so the rule is a surrogate.","surrogate":true}],"assumptions":[{"span":"s5","id":"asm.within_city_limits","meaning":"the place of the road user at the observation lies within the territorial limits of the incorporated city whose ordinances the reading applies, as the map's reading classifies the area"}],"intentions":[],"compositions":[],"residues":[],"binders":[{"name":"subject","class_elements":["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"]}],"applicability":"The subject is a member of the vehicle aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle, its footprint occupies a highway region (st.highway), asm.within_city_limits holds at the observation, and the subject is moving (kin.speed above p.halt_speed_tolerance).","obligation":"No other road user u of the scene (any class) is in contact with the subject (rel.contact), and no other road user u is such that, under constant velocities, the subject's and u's centres approach within p.conflict_horizon (prim.closest_approach_within) to a closest-approach centre distance below p.conflict_centre_clearance (prim.closest_approach_distance). Surrogate: the verdict is evidence of carelessness, not a legal conclusion.","params":["p.halt_speed_tolerance","p.conflict_horizon","p.conflict_centre_clearance"],"narrowings":[{"span":"s1","why":"'drive or operate' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion: a moving vehicle is taken to be driven, whoever or whatever controls it.","kind":"observable_reading","category":"agency"},{"span":"s3","why":"'careless or imprudent' is read only through a collision or a critical conflict with another road user; careless conduct that produces neither (inattention, erratic lane keeping with no one near, harsh braking) is not read.","kind":"reading"}],"scenarios":[{"name":"forbid","expected":"violated","narrative":"The subject car moves at 15 m/s on a highway inside the city (asm.within_city_limits declared true) toward a car halted ahead in its lane; at 2 s from the closest approach the projected centre distance is 1 m, and it does not brake."},{"name":"permit","expected":"compliant","narrative":"The subject car moves at 12 m/s alone on a city highway; no other road user is in the scene, so no contact and no conflict exist."},{"name":"idle","expected":"not_applicable","narrative":"The subject car moves in a private parking lot that is no highway region; it occupies no st.highway."},{"name":"blind","expected":"unknown","narrative":"The subject car moves on a city street close behind a slower car with a projected conflict, but the source does not observe region occupancy, so whether it is on a highway is unknown.","masked":["rel.occupies"]}],"literals":[],"param_proposals":[{"name":"p.halt_speed_tolerance","unit":"m/s","value":0.1,"convention":"the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution","source":"speed resolution of road-user tracking in recorded and simulated traces"},{"name":"p.conflict_horizon","unit":"s","value":3.0,"convention":"time-to-collision threshold of the traffic-conflict technique: a closest approach later than this is not a present danger of a crash","source":"traffic-conflict technique (Swedish TCT, Hydén 1987): time-to-collision thresholds of 1.5 to 3 s"},{"name":"p.conflict_centre_clearance","unit":"m","value":3.0,"convention":"centre-to-centre distance at the closest approach below which the bodies of a passenger car and another road user are taken to collide or nearly collide: about a car's half-length plus half a body width","source":"AASHTO passenger-car design vehicle dimensions (about 5.8 m by 2.1 m)"}],"gaps":[],"gap_resolutions":[]}

{"node_id":"LVMC_11_22_100","law_refs":["LVMC-11-22-100"],"subject":{"binder":"subject","class_elements":["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"]},"segmentation":[{"id":"a1","text":"No person shall ride or drive","role":"obligation"},{"id":"a2","text":"any vehicle","role":"subject"},{"id":"a3","text":"over or across any pavement newly laid or repaired","role":"condition"},{"id":"a4","text":"across or around which there has been placed a barrier","role":"condition"},{"id":"a5","text":"or at or near which there is a person or a sign warning persons against riding or driving over such pavement","role":"condition"},{"id":"a6","text":"or a sign stating that the highway is closed","role":"condition"},{"id":"a7","text":"The provisions of this Section shall not apply to the employees actually engaged in the paving or repair of such pavement","role":"exception"}],"elements":[{"span":"a1","atoms":["kin.speed","rel.occupies"],"derived":[],"justification":"'ride or drive' names who controls the vehicle and is read through its controlled motion ('a vehicle moving on the road is taken to be driven'): kin.speed, 'magnitude of velocity', above p.halt_speed_tolerance; rel.occupies, 'a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region', carries 'over or across' the pavement region bound in a3."},{"span":"a2","atoms":["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"],"derived":[],"justification":"'vehicle' is a defined term of this law with the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle ('every device in, upon or by which any person or property is or may be transported or drawn upon a highway'); claimed as one atom, never expanded."},{"span":"a3","atoms":["rel.occupies","st.roadway","dev.temporary_traffic_control"],"derived":[],"justification":"Nearest atoms only (the span carries a gap): st.roadway, 'the part of a highway improved for vehicular traffic', is where pavement lies but carries no attribute of its surface being newly laid or repaired; dev.temporary_traffic_control, 'cones, barricades, temporary signs and flashers marking works, a closure or an obstruction', marks works but not that the surface it marks is fresh pavement. Neither denotes 'pavement newly laid or repaired'."},{"span":"a4","atoms":["dev.temporary_traffic_control","dev.governs"],"derived":[],"justification":"A barrier placed across or around the pavement is a barricade: dev.temporary_traffic_control, 'cones, barricades, temporary signs and flashers marking works, a closure', tied to the pavement's travel region by dev.governs, 'the travel regions whose traffic the device controls'; governance, not distance, ties the barrier to the stretch it closes. Not a stand-in for a position: the rule does not read where a halt is required from it."},{"span":"a5","atoms":["dev.human_direction","dev.temporary_traffic_control","dev.regulatory_sign","dev.governs"],"derived":[],"justification":"A person warning persons against driving over the pavement is dev.human_direction, 'a person directing traffic and the direction given', role flagger, indication stop; a warning sign is a temporary sign of dev.temporary_traffic_control or a dev.regulatory_sign of code closed_to_traffic. 'at or near which' ties the device to the pavement through dev.governs (the device controls the pavement's travel region), not through a distance."},{"span":"a6","atoms":["dev.regulatory_sign","dev.governs"],"derived":[],"justification":"dev.regulatory_sign, 'a point regulation by catalogue code', code closed_to_traffic, is a sign stating that the highway is closed; dev.governs ties it to the travel region it closes. A prohibition sign is a condition, not a manoeuvre, as its contract says."},{"span":"a7","atoms":["ru.official_vehicle"],"derived":[],"justification":"Nearest atom only (the span carries a gap): ru.official_vehicle, 'a vehicle in official or contracted road service, identifiable by livery or equipment', kind highway_maintenance, states what a road user is, not that it is 'actually engaged in the paving or repair of such pavement': a maintenance vehicle passing through is not engaged, and a contractor's unmarked vehicle may be. No atom records the work a road user is doing at a place."}],"operationalizations":[],"assumptions":[],"intentions":[],"compositions":[],"residues":[],"binders":[{"name":"subject","class_elements":["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"]}],"applicability":"The subject is a member of DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle, is not engaged in the paving or repair of that pavement (the gap ru.road_work_activity), and a stretch of newly laid or repaired pavement p (the gap's region) is in the scene that a barricade (dev.temporary_traffic_control), a flagger signalling stop (dev.human_direction), a warning sign or a closed_to_traffic regulatory sign governs (dev.governs).","obligation":"The subject does not occupy (rel.occupies) the pavement p while moving (kin.speed above p.halt_speed_tolerance).","params":["p.halt_speed_tolerance"],"narrowings":[{"span":"a1","why":"'ride or drive' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion over the pavement.","kind":"observable_reading","category":"agency"},{"span":"a5","why":"'at or near which there is a person or a sign warning' is read as a flagger or a sign governing the pavement's travel region; a warning sign that the source records as governing no region does not trigger the duty.","kind":"observable_reading","category":"status"}],"scenarios":[{"name":"forbid","expected":"violated","narrative":"A car drives at 8 m/s over a lane of fresh asphalt that a row of barricades governs."},{"name":"permit","expected":"compliant","narrative":"A car drives in the open adjacent lane while barricades govern the lane of fresh asphalt; its footprint never overlaps the fresh pavement."},{"name":"idle","expected":"not_applicable","narrative":"A car drives on an ordinary street with no barricade, flagger or closure sign and no fresh pavement in the scene."},{"name":"blind","expected":"unknown","narrative":"A car drives over a lane of fresh asphalt beside barricades, but the source does not observe which region the barricades govern.","masked":["dev.governs"]},{"name":"branch_1","expected":"not_applicable","narrative":"A paving crew's roller, recorded as engaged in paving that stretch, drives over the barricaded fresh asphalt."}],"literals":[],"param_proposals":[{"name":"p.halt_speed_tolerance","unit":"m/s","value":0.1,"convention":"the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution","source":"speed resolution of road-user tracking in recorded and simulated traces"}],"gaps":[{"span":"a3","kind":"atom","proposal":"`st.fresh_pavement` | a stretch of pavement newly laid or repaired and not yet open to travel (uncured asphalt or concrete, fresh surfacing), carried as a region with a reference point and a boundary; it decides where a vehicle may not travel **Not a stand-in for:** a work zone or the devices marking it (`dev.temporary_traffic_control`), or an object on the road (`st.obstruction`) — a closure marks a place, not the state of its surface | general","nearest":"st.roadway ('the part of a highway improved for vehicular traffic': no attribute of the surface's age); dev.temporary_traffic_control ('cones, barricades, temporary signs and flashers marking works, a closure or an obstruction': marks works, not that the surface is newly laid); st.obstruction (kinds debris, excavation, barrier: an object, not the surface)"},{"span":"a7","kind":"atom","proposal":"`ru.road_work_activity` | the road user is engaged, at the observation, in work on the way at its place: paving, surfacing, repair or maintenance of the roadway or of the right-of-way, as the source records the activity; it decides which road users a closure of works does not bind **Not a stand-in for:** the class of a works or maintenance vehicle (`ru.official_vehicle`) — a maintenance vehicle passing through is not engaged in the work, and a contractor's unmarked vehicle may be | general","nearest":"ru.official_vehicle ('a vehicle in official or contracted road service, identifiable by livery or equipment', kind highway_maintenance): a class, which states what the vehicle is, not the work it is doing at the place"}],"gap_resolutions":[]}

lines: {"node_id":"LVMC_11_22_020","law_refs":["LVMC-11-22-020"],"subject":{"binder":"subject","class_elements":["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"]},"segmentation":[{"id":"s1","text":"It is unlawful for any person to drive or operate","role":"obligation"},{"id":"s2","text":"a vehicle of any kind or character","role":"subject"},{"id":"s3","text":"in a careless or imprudent manner","role":"standard"},{"id":"s4","text":"on any highway","role":"condition"},{"id":"s5","text":"in the City","role":"condition"}],"elements":[{"span":"s1","atoms":["kin.speed"],"derived":[],"justification":"'drive or operate' names who controls the vehicle, which no atom observes; per the ontology's section on what is not an atom it is read through the vehicle's controlled motion, 'a vehicle moving on the road is taken to be driven'. kin.speed, 'magnitude of velocity', tells the moving vehicle (speed above p.halt_speed_tolerance) from one at rest; it is used for motion, not as a stand-in for acceleration or a manoeuvre. 'any person' is the one who drives: the duty binds the vehicle's conduct whoever controls it."},{"span":"s2","atoms":["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"],"derived":[],"justification":"'vehicle' is a defined term of this law with the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle: '“Vehicle” means every device in, upon or by which any person or property is or may be transported or drawn upon a highway', with its exceptions (human-powered devices, electric bicycles, EPAMDs, electric scooters) made by the reading's classification. 'of any kind or character' adds no restriction and removes none beyond the definition; the aggregate is one atom and is not expanded."},{"span":"s4","atoms":["rel.occupies","st.highway"],"derived":[],"justification":"Same words and meaning as the index's 'on a highway' -> rel.occupies, st.highway. st.highway: 'the entire public way between its boundary lines, including sidewalks and shoulders', which is the defined 'entire width between the boundary lines of every way dedicated to a public authority'; it is not the roadway, and the words do not narrow to the roadway. rel.occupies: 'a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region' anchors the subject on that highway."}],"operationalizations":[{"span":"s3","standard":"careless or imprudent manner","concepts":["prim.closest_approach_within","prim.closest_approach_distance","rel.contact"],"params":["p.conflict_horizon","p.conflict_centre_clearance"],"convention":"traffic-conflict technique: driving is read as careless or imprudent where, while the subject moves, it collides with another road user (rel.contact) or another road user's centre and the subject's, under constant velocities, approach within p.conflict_horizon to a centre distance below p.conflict_centre_clearance (a critical conflict). Care is a state of mind and the whole duty is this standard, so the rule is a surrogate.","surrogate":true}],"assumptions":[{"span":"s5","id":"asm.within_city_limits","meaning":"the place of the road user at the observation lies within the territorial limits of the incorporated city whose ordinances the reading applies, as the map's reading classifies the area"}],"intentions":[],"compositions":[],"residues":[],"binders":[{"name":"subject","class_elements":["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"]}],"applicability":"The subject is a member of the vehicle aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle, its footprint occupies a highway region (st.highway), asm.within_city_limits holds at the observation, and the subject is moving (kin.speed above p.halt_speed_tolerance).","obligation":"No other road user u of the scene (any class) is in contact with the subject (rel.contact), and no other road user u is such that, under constant velocities, the subject's and u's centres approach within p.conflict_horizon (prim.closest_approach_within) to a closest-approach centre distance below p.conflict_centre_clearance (prim.closest_approach_distance). Surrogate: the verdict is evidence of carelessness, not a legal conclusion.","params":["p.halt_speed_tolerance","p.conflict_horizon","p.conflict_centre_clearance"],"narrowings":[{"span":"s1","why":"'drive or operate' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion: a moving vehicle is taken to be driven, whoever or whatever controls it.","kind":"observable_reading","category":"agency"},{"span":"s3","why":"'careless or imprudent' is read only through a collision or a critical conflict with another road user; careless conduct that produces neither (inattention, erratic lane keeping with no one near, harsh braking) is not read.","kind":"reading"}],"scenarios":[{"name":"forbid","expected":"violated","narrative":"The subject car moves at 15 m/s on a highway inside the city (asm.within_city_limits declared true) toward a car halted ahead in its lane; at 2 s from the closest approach the projected centre distance is 1 m, and it does not brake."},{"name":"permit","expected":"compliant","narrative":"The subject car moves at 12 m/s alone on a city highway; no other road user is in the scene, so no contact and no conflict exist."},{"name":"idle","expected":"not_applicable","narrative":"The subject car moves in a private parking lot that is no highway region; it occupies no st.highway."},{"name":"blind","expected":"unknown","narrative":"The subject car moves on a city street close behind a slower car with a projected conflict, but the source does not observe region occupancy, so whether it is on a highway is unknown.","masked":["rel.occupies"]}],"literals":[],"param_proposals":[{"name":"p.halt_speed_tolerance","unit":"m/s","value":0.1,"convention":"the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution","source":"speed resolution of road-user tracking in recorded and simulated traces"},{"name":"p.conflict_horizon","unit":"s","value":3.0,"convention":"time-to-collision threshold of the traffic-conflict technique: a closest approach later than this is not a present danger of a crash","source":"traffic-conflict technique (Swedish TCT, Hydén 1987): time-to-collision thresholds of 1.5 to 3 s"},{"name":"p.conflict_centre_clearance","unit":"m","value":3.0,"convention":"centre-to-centre distance at the closest approach below which the bodies of a passenger car and another road user are taken to collide or nearly collide: about a car's half-length plus half a body width","source":"AASHTO passenger-car design vehicle dimensions (about 5.8 m by 2.1 m)"}],"gaps":[],"gap_resolutions":[]}

{"node_id":"LVMC_11_22_100","law_refs":["LVMC-11-22-100"],"subject":{"binder":"subject","class_elements":["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"]},"segmentation":[{"id":"a1","text":"No person shall ride or drive","role":"obligation"},{"id":"a2","text":"any vehicle","role":"subject"},{"id":"a3","text":"over or across any pavement newly laid or repaired","role":"condition"},{"id":"a4","text":"across or around which there has been placed a barrier","role":"condition"},{"id":"a5","text":"or at or near which there is a person or a sign warning persons against riding or driving over such pavement","role":"condition"},{"id":"a6","text":"or a sign stating that the highway is closed","role":"condition"},{"id":"a7","text":"The provisions of this Section shall not apply to the employees actually engaged in the paving or repair of such pavement","role":"exception"}],"elements":[{"span":"a1","atoms":["kin.speed","rel.occupies"],"derived":[],"justification":"'ride or drive' names who controls the vehicle and is read through its controlled motion ('a vehicle moving on the road is taken to be driven'): kin.speed, 'magnitude of velocity', above p.halt_speed_tolerance; claimed as one atom, never expanded."},{"span":"a3","atoms":["rel.occupies","st.roadway","dev.temporary_traffic_control"],"derived":[],"justification":"Nearest atoms only (the span carries a gap): st.roadway, 'the part of a highway improved for vehicular traffic', is where pavement lies but carries no attribute of its surface being newly laid or repaired; dev.temporary_traffic_control, 'cones, barricades, temporary signs and flashers marking works, a closure or an obstruction', marks works but not that the surface it marks is fresh pavement. lines: {"node_id":"LVMC_11_22_020","law_refs":["LVMC-11-22-020"],"subject":{"binder":"subject","class_elements":["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"]},"segmentation":[{"id":"s1","text":"It is unlawful for any person to drive or operate","role":"obligation"},{"id":"s2","text":"a vehicle of any kind or character","role":"subject"},{"id":"s3","text":"in a careless or imprudent manner","role":"standard"},{"id":"s4","text":"on any highway","role":"condition"},{"id":"s5","text":"in the City","role":"condition"}],"elements":[{"span":"s1","atoms":["kin.speed"],"derived":[],"justification":"'drive or operate' names who controls the vehicle, which no atom observes; per the ontology's section on what is not an atom it is read through the vehicle's controlled motion, 'a vehicle moving on the road is taken to be driven'. kin.speed, 'magnitude of velocity', tells the moving vehicle (speed above p.halt_speed_tolerance) from one at rest; it is used for motion, not as a stand-in for acceleration or a manoeuvre. 'any person' is the one who drives: the duty binds the vehicle's conduct whoever controls it."},{"span":"s2","atoms":["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"],"derived":[],"justification":"'vehicle' is a defined term of this law with the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle: '“Vehicle” means every device in, upon or by which any person or property is or may be transported or drawn upon a highway', with its exceptions (human-powered devices, electric bicycles, EPAMDs, electric scooters) made by the reading's classification. Care is a state of mind and the whole duty is this standard, so the rule is a surrogate.","surrogate":true}],"assumptions":[{"span":"s5","id":"asm.within_city_limits","meaning":"the place of the road user at the observation lies within the territorial limits of the incorporated city whose ordinances the reading applies, as the map's reading classifies the area"}],"intentions":[],"compositions":[],"residues":[],"binders":[{"name":"subject","class_elements":["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"]}],"applicability":"The subject is a member of the vehicle aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle, its footprint occupies a highway region (st.highway), asm.within_city_limits holds at the observation, and the subject is moving (kin.speed above p.halt_speed_tolerance).","obligation":"No other road user u of the scene (any class) is in contact with the subject (rel.contact), and no other road user u is such that, under constant velocities, the subject's and u's centres approach within p.conflict_horizon (prim.closest_approach_within) to a closest-approach centre distance below p.conflict_centre_clearance (prim.closest_approach_distance). and LVMC_11_30_070 does not apply to it (ruleApplies false).","obligation":"For every vehicle v (DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle) that occupies the roadway the subject occupies and crosses (re-bound with the same selection): the subject is not in contact with v (rel.contact), and it is not the case that the subject is moving (kin.speed above p.halt_speed_tolerance) while the subject's and v's centres, under constant velocities, approach within p.conflict_horizon (prim.closest_approach_within) to a centre distance below p.conflict_centre_clearance (prim.closest_approach_distance).","params":["p.halt_speed_tolerance","p.crossing_motion_cos","p.conflict_horizon","p.conflict_centre_clearance"],"narrowings":[{"span":"f4","why":"'shall yield' is read as not proceeding into a danger of a crash with a vehicle on the roadway: a pedestrian at rest yields, and one moving while no conflict with any vehicle is projected yields too.","kind":"reading"},{"span":"f5","why":"the right-of-way's 'direction, speed and proximity' are read only through the constant-velocity closest approach of the two centres; lines: {"node_id":"LVMC_11_27_010_A","law_refs":["LVMC-11-27-010-A"],"subject":{"binder":"subject","class_elements":["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"]},"segmentation":[{"id":"c1","text":"Except as otherwise provided in Subsection (B)","role":"exception"},{"id":"c2","text":"it is unlawful to operate","role":"obligation"},{"id":"c3","text":"a motorized vehicle","role":"subject"},{"id":"c4","text":"upon or within a right-of-way that:","role":"condition"},{"id":"c5","text":"(1) Has been designated on an official trails plan as an equestrian trail, multi-use trail, or other trail not intended for use by motorized vehicles;","role":"condition"},{"id":"c6","text":"(2) Has been dedicated to the City for use as such a trail;","role":"condition"},{"id":"c7","text":"and (3) Has been posted with appropriate signs to indicate that motorized vehicles are prohibited.","role":"condition"},{"id":"c8","text":"The provisions of Subsection (A) do not apply to: (1) An emergency vehicle;","role":"exception"},{"id":"c9","text":"(2) Any vehicle that is being used in connection with maintenance of the right-of-way;","role":"exception"},{"id":"c10","text":"or (3) Any motorized wheelchair or other device that is designed for and used by a mobility-impaired person.","role":"exception"}],"elements":[{"span":"c2","atoms":["kin.speed"],"derived":[],"justification":"'operate' names who controls the vehicle and is read through its controlled motion ('a vehicle moving on the road is taken to be driven'): kin.speed, 'magnitude of velocity', above p.halt_speed_tolerance. Same reading as the index's 'when operating a vehicle' -> kin.speed."},{"span":"c3","atoms":["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle","ru.motor_vehicle","ru.motorcycle","ru.moped","ru.bus","ru.transit_bus","ru.school_bus","ru.truck","ru.taxicab","ru.tour_bus_or_limousine","ru.commercial_motor_vehicle"],"derived":[],"justification":"'vehicle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle ('every device in, upon or by which any person or property is or may be transported or drawn upon a highway'). The law's own word 'motorized' limits which members the duty reads: it leaves out vehicles with no motor (animal-drawn vehicles, trailers by themselves). The motorized classes are ru.motor_vehicle ('a self-propelled vehicle other than a rail vehicle'), the powered two-wheelers it excludes and classes separately (ru.motorcycle 'motor vehicle on two or three wheels', ru.moped 'a low-power two- or three-wheeler with a small engine or motor'), and the classes whose contracts make them motor vehicles or powered passenger and goods vehicles (ru.bus, ru.transit_bus, ru.school_bus, ru.truck, ru.taxicab, ru.tour_bus_or_limousine, ru.commercial_motor_vehicle). The aggregate stays the class; the classes are the qualifier beside it."},{"span":"c4","atoms":["rel.occupies","st.travel_region"],"derived":[],"justification":"'upon or within a right-of-way' places the subject on a strip of way: rel.occupies, 'a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region', on a travel region (st.travel_region, the union of the kinds a device can govern), the region the posted sign of c7 governs. The right-of-way's legal character is carried by c5-c7."},{"span":"c7","atoms":["dev.regulatory_sign","dev.governs"],"derived":[],"justification":"dev.regulatory_sign, 'a point regulation by catalogue code', code motor_vehicles_prohibited, is a sign indicating that motorized vehicles are prohibited; dev.governs, 'the travel regions whose traffic the device controls', ties it to the region the subject occupies. 'appropriate' and 'posted' are legal status, read through the sign's presence."},{"span":"c8","atoms":["ru.emergency_vehicle"],"derived":[],"justification":"ru.emergency_vehicle, 'vehicle of a class the jurisdiction designates as emergency'. The words name the class alone, not a responding emergency vehicle, so the exclusion 'Not a stand-in for: a responding emergency vehicle' does not apply."},{"span":"c9","atoms":["ru.official_vehicle"],"derived":[],"justification":"Nearest atom only (the span carries a gap): ru.official_vehicle, 'a vehicle in official or contracted road service, identifiable by livery or equipment', kind highway_maintenance or municipal, states what a vehicle is, not that it 'is being used in connection with maintenance of the right-of-way': a maintenance vehicle using the trail as a shortcut is not, and a contractor's unmarked truck may be. No atom records the work a road user is doing at a place."}],"operationalizations":[],"assumptions":[{"span":"c5","id":"asm.designated_trail","meaning":"the place of the road user at the observation lies within a right-of-way that an official trails plan designates as an equestrian trail, a multi-use trail or another trail not intended for use by motorized vehicles, as the map's reading records"},{"span":"c6","id":"asm.trail_dedicated_to_city","meaning":"the right-of-way at the place of the road user at the observation has been dedicated to the city for use as a trail, as the map's reading records"}],"intentions":[],"compositions":[],"residues":[{"span":"c1","why":"Subsection (B) is the text's own exception list, carried by c8-c10; the reference adds no restriction of its own, so the duty is the same whether or not its words are read.","scope":"none"},{"span":"c10","why":"A motorized wheelchair or other device designed for and used by a mobility-impaired person carries its user as a pedestrian (the pedestrian definition: 'a person in a manual or motorized wheelchair'); such a device carries none of the motorized vehicle classes the subject must carry (c3), so the duty is the same whether or not the exception is read.","scope":"none"}],"binders":[{"name":"subject","class_elements":["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"]}],"applicability":"The subject is a member of DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle and carries one of the motorized classes (ru.motor_vehicle, ru.motorcycle, ru.moped, ru.bus, ru.transit_bus, ru.school_bus, ru.truck, ru.taxicab, ru.tour_bus_or_limousine, ru.commercial_motor_vehicle); it is not an ru.emergency_vehicle, and it is not being used in maintenance of the right-of-way (the gap ru.road_work_activity); its footprint occupies a travel region r (st.travel_region) that a dev.regulatory_sign of code motor_vehicles_prohibited governs (dev.governs); and asm.designated_trail and asm.trail_dedicated_to_city hold at the observation.","obligation":"The subject is not moving: its kin.speed is at or below p.halt_speed_tolerance while it occupies that region r.","params":["p.halt_speed_tolerance"],"narrowings":[{"span":"c2","why":"'operate' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion: a motorized vehicle moving on the trail is operated; one at rest there is not.","kind":"observable_reading","category":"agency"},{"span":"c7","why":"'posted with appropriate signs' is read through the presence of a motor_vehicles_prohibited regulatory sign governing the region the subject occupies; a trail the source maps as no travel region, or whose sign it records as governing nothing, does not engage the duty.","kind":"observable_reading","category":"status"}],"scenarios":[{"name":"forbid","expected":"violated","narrative":"A motorcycle rides at 6 m/s on a path governed by a motor_vehicles_prohibited sign; the trace declares asm.designated_trail and asm.trail_dedicated_to_city true."},{"name":"permit","expected":"compliant","narrative":"A car stands at rest (speed 0) on the same signed trail path, both assumptions declared true."},{"name":"idle","expected":"not_applicable","narrative":"A car drives on an ordinary street that no motor_vehicles_prohibited sign governs."},{"name":"blind","expected":"unknown","narrative":"A car is on the signed trail path with both assumptions declared true, but its speed is not observed.","masked":["kin.speed"]},{"name":"branch_1","expected":"not_applicable","narrative":"An ambulance (ru.emergency_vehicle) drives at 5 m/s on the signed trail path, both assumptions declared true."}],"literals":[],"param_proposals":[{"name":"p.halt_speed_tolerance","unit":"m/s","value":0.1,"convention":"the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution","source":"speed resolution of road-user tracking in recorded and simulated traces"}],"gaps":[{"span":"c9","kind":"atom","proposal":"`ru.road_work_activity` | the road user is engaged, at the observation, in work on the way at its place: paving, surfacing, repair or maintenance of the roadway or of the right-of-way, as the source records the activity; it decides which road users a closure of works does not bind **Not a stand-in for:** the class of a works or maintenance vehicle (`ru.official_vehicle`) — a maintenance vehicle passing through is not engaged in the work, and a contractor's unmarked vehicle may be | general","nearest":"ru.official_vehicle ('a vehicle in official or contracted road service, identifiable by livery or equipment', kinds highway_maintenance, municipal): a class, which states what the vehicle is, not the work it is being used for at the place"}],"gap_resolutions":[]}

{"node_id":"LVMC_11_30_030","law_refs":["LVMC-11-30-030"],"subject":{"binder":"subject","class_elements":["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"]},"segmentation":[{"id":"d1","text":"Whenever any vehicle is stopped at a marked crosswalk or at any unmarked crosswalk at an intersection to permit a pedestrian to cross the roadway","role":"trigger"},{"id":"d2","text":"the driver of any other vehicle","role":"subject"},{"id":"d3","text":"approaching from the rear shall not overtake and pass such stopped vehicle","role":"obligation"}],"elements":[{"span":"d1","atoms":["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle","st.crosswalk","st.region_geometry","rel.occupies","st.travel_region","prim.region_offset_along","ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-165::pedestrian"],"derived":["drv.motion.complete_halt"],"justification":"'any vehicle' is a member b of the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle, quantified in the rule. 'is stopped' is drv.motion.complete_halt on b ('at rest at the observation', speed at or below p.halt_speed_tolerance). 'at a marked crosswalk or at any unmarked crosswalk at an intersection' is a crosswalk c: st.crosswalk, 'marked crossing, or the unmarked prolongation of sidewalks at an intersection', which is the defined crosswalk in both of its branches; b is at c where its body occupies c (rel.occupies) or lies within p.stop_point_tolerance of it (st.region_geometry, 'the ground distance from a road user's body outline to it'), and c lies ahead of or under b along the direction of a carrier b occupies (prim.region_offset_along not negative; carrier of kind st.travel_region): a vehicle halted beyond the crossing is not stopped at it. 'to permit a pedestrian to cross the roadway' is a purpose, read through the conduct it explains: a pedestrian (DEF-NRS-484A-165::pedestrian, 'a person afoot, a person in a manual or motorized wheelchair') occupies the crosswalk c (rel.occupies) at the same observation."},{"span":"d2","atoms":["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"],"derived":[],"justification":"'the driver of any other vehicle' names the vehicle whose conduct is judged, a member of DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle other than b; same mapping as the index's 'The driver of a vehicle'. 'driver' is a role, read through the vehicle's controlled motion."},{"span":"d3","atoms":[],"derived":["drv.interaction.overtake_pass"],"justification":"'approaching from the rear ... overtake and pass such stopped vehicle' is the manoeuvre of drv.interaction.overtake_pass(subject, b): the subject, travelling in the same direction as b, comes from having b ahead of it (approaching from the rear) to having b behind it. 'such stopped vehicle' is the same b bound by the trigger."}],"operationalizations":[],"assumptions":[],"intentions":[],"compositions":[],"residues":[],"binders":[{"name":"subject","class_elements":["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"]}],"applicability":"The subject is a member of DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle, and some other vehicle b of the scene (DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle, not the subject) is, at the observation or at some observation of the p.overtake_window behind it, at a complete halt (drv.motion.complete_halt with p.halt_speed_tolerance) at a crosswalk c (its body occupying c or within p.stop_point_tolerance of c, with c not behind it along the direction of a carrier it occupies) while a pedestrian occupies c.","obligation":"There is no other vehicle b such that, at the observation, the subject overtakes and passes b (drv.interaction.overtake_pass(subject, b) with window p.overtake_window and same_dir_cos p.overtake_same_direction_cos, at its recognition) and the trigger held for b at some observation of that act: from the last observation of the window behind at which b was ahead of the subject with headings aligned, up to the observation itself, b was at a complete halt at a crosswalk c occupied by a pedestrian, as stated in the applicability.","params":["p.halt_speed_tolerance","p.stop_point_tolerance","p.overtake_window","p.overtake_same_direction_cos"],"narrowings":[{"span":"d1","why":"'to permit a pedestrian to cross the roadway' is a purpose, read through the conduct it explains: the vehicle is halted at the crosswalk while a pedestrian occupies that crosswalk; a halt for a pedestrian still waiting on the curb is not read.","kind":"observable_reading","category":"purpose"},{"span":"d2","why":"'the driver' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion: the duty binds the overtaking vehicle whoever controls it.","kind":"observable_reading","category":"agency"}],"scenarios":[{"name":"forbid","expected":"violated","narrative":"Car b halts 1 m before a marked crosswalk in the right lane while a pedestrian walks on the crosswalk; the subject car, coming up behind b in the same direction, moves to the left lane and passes b within 6 s while b is still halted and the pedestrian still on the crosswalk."},{"name":"permit","expected":"compliant","narrative":"Car b halts before a marked crosswalk with a pedestrian on it; the subject car, behind b in the same direction, halts behind b and does not pass it."},{"name":"idle","expected":"not_applicable","narrative":"The subject car drives along a street; no vehicle is halted at any crosswalk, and no other vehicle is in the scene."},{"name":"blind","expected":"unknown","narrative":"Car b stands before a marked crosswalk with a pedestrian on it while the subject passes it, but the speed of b is not observed, so whether b is stopped is unknown.","masked":["kin.speed"]},{"name":"occasion_d1","expected":"violated","narrative":"Car b is halted at an unmarked crosswalk at an intersection with a pedestrian on it during the first 3 s of the subject's pass; the pedestrian then reaches the far curb and b remains halted while the subject completes the pass 2 s later."},{"name":"occasion_d1_outside","expected":"compliant","narrative":"Car b halts at a marked crosswalk with a pedestrian on it while the subject waits behind; the pedestrian clears the crosswalk and b moves off before the subject begins to move out; the subject passes b, which is then moving, 8 s later, with no pedestrian on the crosswalk during the pass."}],"occasion":{"act":"drv.interaction.overtake_pass","boundary":"window","window":"p.overtake_window","under_way":{"words":"overtake and pass","atoms":["kin.speed","rel.bearing","rel.longitudinal_overlap","rel.same_direction"],"derived":[],"justification":"An observation inside the pass is one at or after the last observation of the window behind at which b was ahead of the subject with headings aligned (rel.bearing longitudinal component positive, rel.longitudinal_overlap negative, rel.same_direction within p.overtake_same_direction_cos), at which the subject is moving (kin.speed, 'magnitude of velocity', above p.halt_speed_tolerance), and before b is behind the subject: it is read from the subject's motion and the two road users' relative position, not from the region either occupies."},"spans":{"d1":"some_moment"}},"literals":[],"param_proposals":[{"name":"p.halt_speed_tolerance","unit":"m/s","value":0.1,"convention":"the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution","source":"speed resolution of road-user tracking in recorded and simulated traces"},{"name":"p.stop_point_tolerance","unit":"m","value":2.0,"convention":"the body-to-mark gap within which a halt counts as at the mark: a stop line's set-back before a crossing plus a placement of an overtaking manoeuvre on an urban street, from having the overtaken vehicle ahead to having it behind","source":"AASHTO Green Book passing-manoeuvre model: passing times of about 4 to 11 {"node_id":"LVMC_11_30_050","law_refs":["LVMC-11-30-050"],"subject":{"binder":"subject","class_elements":["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-165::pedestrian"]},"segmentation":[{"id":"e1","text":"No pedestrian","role":"subject"},{"id":"e2","text":"shall cross a roadway","role":"trigger"},{"id":"e3","text":"at any place other than by a route at right angles to the curb or by the shortest route to the opposite curb","role":"obligation"},{"id":"e4","text":"except in a crosswalk","role":"exception"}],"elements":[{"span":"e1","atoms":["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-165::pedestrian"],"derived":[],"justification":"'pedestrian' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-165::pedestrian ('a person afoot, a person in a manual or motorized wheelchair, or a person on an electric personal assistive mobility device'); one atom, never expanded."},{"span":"e2","atoms":["rel.occupies","st.roadway","st.lane"],"derived":["drv.motion.moving_across_carrier"],"justification":"Crossing a roadway is being on it and moving across it: rel.occupies, 'a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region', on st.roadway, 'the part of a highway improved for vehicular traffic, excluding shoulder' (the defined roadway; not the sidewalk or shoulder), and drv.motion.moving_across_carrier(subject, k) with cos_max p.crossing_motion_cos on a carrier k the pedestrian occupies (a lane, st.lane, or the roadway itself), whose designated direction is the direction the curbs run: moving across, not along, the way. Walking along the roadway is not crossing it."},{"span":"e3","atoms":[],"derived":["drv.motion.moving_across_carrier"],"justification":"'a route at right angles to the curb' is motion at right angles to the direction the roadway's carriers run, which is the curb's direction: drv.motion.moving_across_carrier(subject, k) with cos_max p.right_angle_crossing_cos, the tolerance of 'at right angles' on sampled headings. 'the shortest route to the opposite curb' between curbs that run parallel is the same perpendicular route."},{"span":"e4","atoms":["rel.occupies","st.crosswalk"],"derived":[],"justification":"st.crosswalk, 'marked crossing, or the unmarked prolongation of sidewalks at an intersection', is the defined crosswalk; rel.occupies places the pedestrian in it. Not a sidewalk."}],"operationalizations":[],"assumptions":[],"intentions":[],"compositions":[],"residues":[],"binders":[{"name":"subject","class_elements":["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-165::pedestrian"]}],"applicability":"The subject is a member of DEF-NRS-484A-165::pedestrian, occupies a roadway (st.roadway), does not occupy a crosswalk (st.crosswalk), and occupies a carrier k (a lane, st.lane, or a roadway) across which {"concept_id":"drv.interaction.overtake_pass","kind":"formula","contract":"Road user a overtakes and passes road user b from the rear: a, travelling in the same direction as b, comes from having b ahead of it to having b behind it. b is ahead of a where the longitudinal component of b's bearing in a's frame (rel.bearing) is positive and the two bodies' projections on a's heading share no length (rel.longitudinal_overlap negative); b is behind a where that component is negative and the projections share no length. The act begins at the last observation of the window behind at which b was ahead of a with their headings aligned within same_dir_cos (rel.same_direction). The act is recognized at the observation at which b is behind a and was not behind a at the previous observation, where b was ahead of a with headings aligned at some observation of the window behind. The concept holds at that observation only, and not again until b has again been ahead of a and then comes to be behind it. Conduct before the window behind is not read: a pass that takes longer than the window is not recognized. It denotes the relative motion of the two road users only: it says nothing of the lanes they occupy, of whether b moves, or of why a passes. Not denoted: a drawing alongside b that does not clear b; b ahead of a only while their headings are not aligned (a road user met head-on or crossing); b behind a at every observation of the window.","definition":null,"args":[{"name":"a","sort":"track"},{"name":"b","sort":"track"}],"params":[{"name":"window","unit":"s","meaning":"the longest duration of a pass the concept recognizes: how far behind the observation it looks for b ahead of a"},{"name":"same_dir_cos","unit":"ratio","meaning":"cosine of the largest heading difference at which a and b count as travelling in the same direction"}],"act":{"boundary":"window","window":"window","onset":"The act begins at the last observation of the window behind at which b was ahead of a with their headings aligned within same_dir_cos (rel.same_direction).","recognition":"The act is recognized at the observation at which b is behind a and was not behind a at the previous observation, where b was ahead of a with headings aligned at some observation of the window behind.","extent":"The concept holds at that observation only, and not again until b has again been ahead of a and then comes to be behind it.","history":"Conduct before the window behind is not read: a pass that takes longer than the window is not recognized."},"elements":[{"span":"the longitudinal component of b's bearing in a's frame (rel.bearing)","atoms":["rel.bearing"],"concepts":[],"justification":"rel.bearing: 'direction of b from a in a's frame (for \"on the right of\", \"immediately to the rear\")'; {"concept_id":"drv.motion.moving_across_carrier","kind":"formula","contract":"Road user a moves across the designated direction of travel of carrier region r: a is moving, its speed (kin.speed) above speed_tol, and its velocity (kin.velocity) makes with r's designated direction (st.lane_direction) an angle whose cosine, in absolute value, is at most cos_max: the absolute value of the dot product of the velocity with the normalised direction is at most cos_max times the speed. It is a state at one observation: it says nothing of whether a occupies r, of where a began or will end its movement, or of how long it has moved so. {"concept_id":"drv.interaction.overtake_pass","kind":"formula","contract":"Road user a overtakes and passes road user b from the rear: a, travelling in the same direction as b, comes from having b ahead of it to having b behind it. b is ahead of a where the longitudinal component of b's bearing in a's frame (rel.bearing) is positive and the two bodies' projections on a's heading share no length (rel.longitudinal_overlap negative); b is behind a where that component is negative and the projections share no length. The act begins at the last observation of the window behind at which b was ahead of a with their headings aligned within same_dir_cos (rel.same_direction). The act is recognized at the observation at which b is behind a and was not behind a at the previous observation, where b was ahead of a with headings aligned at some observation of the window behind. The concept holds at that observation only, and not again until b has again been ahead of a and then comes to be behind it. Conduct before the window behind is not read: a pass that takes longer than the window is not recognized. It denotes the relative motion of the two road users only: it says nothing of the lanes they occupy, of whether b moves, or of why a passes. Not denoted: a drawing alongside b that does not clear b; b ahead of a only while their headings are not aligned (a road user met head-on or crossing); b behind a at every observation of the window.","definition":null,"args":[{"name":"a","sort":"track"},{"name":"b","sort":"track"}],"params":[{"name":"window","unit":"s","meaning":"the longest duration of a pass the concept recognizes: how far behind the observation it looks for b ahead of a"},{"name":"same_dir_cos","unit":"ratio","meaning":"cosine of the largest heading difference at which a and b count as travelling in the same direction"}],"act":{"boundary":"window","window":"window","onset":"The act begins at the last observation of the window behind at which b was ahead of a with their headings aligned within same_dir_cos (rel.same_direction).","recognition":"The act is recognized at the observation at which b is behind a and was not behind a at the previous observation, where b was ahead of a with headings aligned at some observation of the window behind.","extent":"The concept holds at that observation only, and not again until b has again been ahead of a and then comes to be behind it.","history":"Conduct before the window behind is not read: a pass that takes longer than the window is not recognized."},"elements":[{"span":"the longitudinal component of b's bearing in a's frame (rel.bearing)","atoms":["rel.bearing"],"concepts":[],"justification":"rel.bearing: 'direction of b from a in a's frame (for \"on the right of\", \"immediately to the rear\")'; its longitudinal component's sign tells b ahead of a from b behind it."},{"span":"the two bodies' projections on a's heading share no length (rel.longitudinal_overlap negative)","atoms":["rel.longitudinal_overlap"],"concepts":[],"justification":"rel.longitudinal_overlap: 'the length the two footprints' projections on that axis share, negative for the gap between the projections'; a negative value means the bodies are not side by side, so a has cleared b (or not yet reached it). Used as a projection, not as a contact or a distance."},{"span":"with their headings aligned within same_dir_cos (rel.same_direction)","atoms":["rel.same_direction"],"concepts":[],"justification":"rel.same_direction: 'headings aligned: the cosine of the angle between the headings is above its tolerance', with the tolerance same_dir_cos; it tells an overtaking from a meeting or a crossing."}],"residues":[],"literals":[],"scenarios":[{"name":"holds","expected":"compliant","narrative":"a follows b in the same lane 15 m behind at 12 m/s while b is halted; a moves to the adjacent lane, draws alongside and, 4 s after b was last ahead of it, has b 3 m behind it: at that observation the concept holds."},{"name":"fails","expected":"violated","narrative":"a follows b, moves to the adjacent lane and draws alongside b, then halts with the two bodies still side by side; b never comes to be behind a within the window."},{"name":"blind","expected":"unknown","narrative":"a draws past b in the adjacent lane, but the bearing of b from a is not observed.","masked":["rel.bearing"]}],"used_by":["LVMC_11_30_030"],"supersedes":null}

{"concept_id":"drv.motion.moving_across_carrier","kind":"formula","contract":"Road user a moves across the designated direction of travel of carrier region r: a is moving, its speed (kin.speed) above speed_tol, and its velocity (kin.velocity) makes with r's designated direction (st.lane_direction) an angle whose cosine, in absolute value, is at most cos_max: the absolute value of the dot product of the velocity with the normalised direction is at most cos_max times the speed. Either sense of crossing is denoted: the sign of the direction does not matter. It is a state at one observation: it says nothing of whether a occupies r, of where a began or will end its movement, or of how long it has moved so. Not denoted: a road user at rest or moving at or below speed_tol; a road user moving more nearly along r's direction than cos_max allows. Where r carries no designated direction, or a's velocity is not observed, it is unknown.","definition":null,"args":[{"name":"a","sort":"track"},{"name":"r","sort":"region"}],"params":[{"name":"speed_tol","unit":"m/s","meaning":"the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement"},{"name":"cos_max","unit":"ratio","meaning":"the largest absolute cosine between the velocity and the carrier's designated direction at which the motion counts as across the carrier"}],"elements":[{"span":"its speed (kin.speed) above speed_tol","atoms":["kin.speed"],"concepts":[],"justification":"kin.speed: 'magnitude of velocity' (m/s); above speed_tol the road user is moving."},{"span":"its velocity (kin.velocity)","atoms":["kin.velocity"],"concepts":[],"justification":"kin.velocity: 'velocity vector' (m/s, world frame); its dot product with the direction gives the motion along the carrier."},{"span":"r's designated direction (st.lane_direction)","atoms":["st.lane_direction"],"concepts":[],"justification":"st.lane_direction: 'direction of travel designated for a structure a vehicle travels in — a lane, ... or a roadway', read normalised; a place no carrier covers has none (unknown)."}],"residues":[],"literals":[],"scenarios":[{"name":"holds","expected":"compliant","narrative":"A pedestrian on a lane whose direction is east walks north at 1.4 m/s: the dot product is zero, at most cos_max times the speed."},{"name":"fails","expected":"violated","narrative":"A pedestrian on the same lane walks east along it at 1.4 m/s: the absolute cosine is 1, above cos_max."},{"name":"blind","expected":"unknown","narrative":"A pedestrian on the lane moves, but its velocity is not observed.","masked":["kin.velocity"]}],"used_by":["LVMC_11_30_050","LVMC_11_30_060_A","LVMC_11_30_060_B"],"supersedes":null}

lines: {"node_id":"LVMC_11_27_010_A","law_refs":["LVMC-11-27-010-A"],"subject":{"binder":"subject","class_elements":["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"]},"segmentation":[{"id":"c1","text":"Except as otherwise provided in Subsection (B)","role":"exception"},{"id":"c2","text":"it is unlawful to operate","role":"obligation"},{"id":"c3","text":"a motorized vehicle","role":"subject"},{"id":"c4","text":"upon or within a right-of-way that:","role":"condition"},{"id":"c5","text":"(1) Has been designated on an official trails plan as an equestrian trail, multi-use trail, or other trail not intended for use by motorized vehicles;","role":"condition"},{"id":"c6","text":"(2) Has been dedicated to the City for use as such a trail;","role":"condition"},{"id":"c7","text":"and (3) Has been posted with appropriate signs to indicate that motorized vehicles are prohibited.","role":"condition"},{"id":"c8","text":"The provisions of Subsection (A) do not apply to: (1) An emergency vehicle;","role":"exception"},{"id":"c9","text":"(2) Any vehicle that is being used in connection with maintenance of the right-of-way;","role":"exception"},{"id":"c10","text":"or (3) Any motorized wheelchair or other device that is designed for and used by a mobility-impaired person.","role":"exception"}],"elements":[{"span":"c2","atoms":["kin.speed"],"derived":[],"justification":"'operate' names who controls the vehicle and is read through its controlled motion ('a vehicle moving on the road is taken to be driven'): kin.speed, 'magnitude of velocity', above p.halt_speed_tolerance. Same reading as the index's 'when operating a vehicle' -> kin.speed."},{"span":"c3","atoms":["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle","ru.motor_vehicle","ru.motorcycle","ru.moped","ru.bus","ru.transit_bus","ru.school_bus","ru.truck","ru.taxicab","ru.tour_bus_or_limousine","ru.commercial_motor_vehicle"],"derived":[],"justification":"'vehicle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle ('every device in, upon or by which any person or property is or may be transported or drawn upon a highway'). The law's own word 'motorized' limits which members the duty reads: it leaves out vehicles with no motor (animal-drawn vehicles, trailers by themselves). The motorized classes are ru.motor_vehicle ('a self-propelled vehicle other than a rail vehicle'), the powered two-wheelers it excludes and classes separately (ru.motorcycle 'motor vehicle on two or three wheels', ru.moped 'a low-power two- or three-wheeler with a small engine or motor'), and the classes whose contracts make them motor vehicles or powered passenger and goods vehicles (ru.bus, ru.transit_bus, ru.school_bus, ru.truck, ru.taxicab, ru.tour_bus_or_limousine, ru.commercial_motor_vehicle). The aggregate stays the class; the classes are the qualifier beside it."},{"span":"c4","atoms":["rel.occupies","st.travel_region"],"derived":[],"justification":"'upon or within a right-of-way' places the subject on a strip of way: rel.occupies, 'a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region', on a travel region (st.travel_region, the union of the kinds a device can govern), the region the posted sign of c7 governs. The right-of-way's legal character is carried by c5-c7."},{"span":"c7","atoms":["dev.regulatory_sign","dev.governs"],"derived":[],"justification":"dev.regulatory_sign, 'a point regulation by catalogue code', code motor_vehicles_prohibited, is a sign indicating that motorized vehicles are prohibited; dev.governs, 'the travel regions whose traffic the device controls', ties it to the region the subject occupies. 'appropriate' and 'posted' are legal status, read through the sign's presence."},{"span":"c8","atoms":["ru.emergency_vehicle"],"derived":[],"justification":"ru.emergency_vehicle, 'vehicle of a class the jurisdiction designates as emergency'. The words name the class alone, not a responding emergency vehicle, so the exclusion 'Not a stand-in for: a responding emergency vehicle' does not apply."},{"span":"c9","atoms":["ru.official_vehicle"],"derived":[],"justification":"Nearest atom only (the span carries a gap): ru.official_vehicle, 'a vehicle in official or contracted road service, identifiable by livery or equipment', kind highway_maintenance or municipal, states what a vehicle is, not that it 'is being used in connection with maintenance of the right-of-way': a maintenance vehicle using the trail as a shortcut is not, and a contractor's unmarked truck may be.
